svg.title: Follow values and dependencies across two memory domains
svg.desc: Explicit-copy baseline: X = [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]], FP32, packed shape (2,3)
svg.text: Follow values and dependencies across two memory domains
Explicit-copy baseline: X = [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]], FP32, packed shape (2,3)
Host RAM: prepared X, separate destination Y
X has six four-byte values: 24 bytes. Keep it immutable during transfer.
The host process owns the transfer contract; CPU ownership does not prove GPU completion.
H2D → device X: 24 bytes of input payload
A dependent operation may read X only after the copy is ready in its scope.
An address, dtype and shape identify different aspects of the tensor contract.
Expected Y = [[3,5,7],[9,11,13]]; device X/Y are separate allocations.
Logical device reads/writes are not measured DRAM traffic or interconnect payload.
D2H → host Y: another 24 bytes; observe completion
Only then may the CPU consume the result and authorize last-use cleanup.
A quick submission return or cancellation does not revoke outstanding accesses.
48 cross-boundary payload bytes; no hardware latency is implied by this constructed probe.
